name: Teatro Real
funding: The Comunidad de Madrid gave 3,8 millones de euros for the 2024 season. The Ayuntamiento de Madrid granted 1,3 millones de euros for 2024.

name: CA2M Centro de Arte Dos de Mayo
funding: Funded by the Comunidad de Madrid.

name: Es Baluard Museu
funding: Govern balear, Consell de Mallorca, Palma council and Fundació d'Art Serra form the foundation. Sponsors: Fundació Baleària, Caixa Colonya, El Corte Inglés, Summum Hotel Group, Hotel Saratoga.

name: Tabakalera (International Centre for Contemporary Culture)
funding: Public centre funded by Gipuzkoa council, San Sebastián city and the Basque government.

name: Centro Botín
funding: Run by Fundación Botín. Patrons: Fundación Mutua Madrileña, Fundación Prosegur, Roche España and two public tourism bodies. Strategic sponsors: Fundación EDP, Plenitude (Eni) and CESINE.

name: IVAM Institut Valencià d'Art Modern
funding: Run by the Generalitat Valenciana's culture department. No operating budget found. It bought 16 works by 14 women artists for about EUR 1M.

name: Artium Museoa
funding: Basque public museum funded mainly by the Álava provincial council.

name: Colomboscope
funding: Run by the independent Fold Media Collective. Named: founding partners Goethe-Institut, British Council and Alliance Française, plus individual Friends. The page's 33 partner and patron logos carry no names.

name: Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art Sri Lanka
funding: Non-profit set up in 2019, with no fixed venue. Founding Patrons are individuals; the John Keells Foundation was named primary sponsor in March 2020.

name: The Muse Multi Studios
funding: Won Culture Resource's Abbara Program grant (round 7, 2022). The Australian Government and Creative Australia support its Qubit fellowship (2026). The Spanish Embassy is a named partner.

name: Lunds Konsthall
funding: Municipal kunsthalle run by Lund municipality.
